panels.alt: Every seed connects its isolated and communicating colony mean; dark line with open diamonds marks condition means.
All paired seed differences with jitter and descriptive violin, zero reference, and paired mean with the available report interval.
ΔF = isolated minus communicating. Positive values indicate lower F with communication in this reduced categorical protocol.
Filled circles: isolated. Open diamonds: sharing. Fine lines preserve pairing. Dark line / open diamonds: condition means.
One open diamond per seed; vertical jitter carries no outcome meaning. Violin is descriptive. Dark dotted rule marks zero contrast.
Paired mean ΔF: +3.311 nats. Independent unit: configured seed; n = 480.
Analysis unit: configured seed with within-seed paired conditions. Agents and ordered steps remain nested within seed.
Reduced-protocol comparison. It does not establish a general communication benefit or reconstruct the complete source protocol.
